Fantastic dinner at An Bang Beach: experiential barbecue, exquisite wonton soup, and super prices!
Aug 2026 • Couples
If you find yourself at An Bang Beach, this restaurant is an absolutely unmissable stop! Excellent quality food, pleasant atmosphere, and really very affordable prices.
The real highlight of the evening was the barbecue: a truly beautiful and fun experience, since the meat is served already sliced but raw, along with a small brazier with coals directly at the table so you can cook it on the spot according to your own tastes. In addition to the grilled meat, we tried a wonderful noodle soup served with wontons (dumplings) and fresh shrimp, rich in flavor and absolutely perfect.
A huge round of applause goes to the staff, who are always extremely kind, welcoming, and smiling.
Just one fundamental piece of advice: definitely book in advance! The place is in high demand, and without a reservation, you really risk not finding a seat. Highly recommended from every point of view!
